name: burnzombies
description: Clear abandoned agent helpers and reclaim resources on your Mac.
long_description: BurnZombies keeps your agent environment clear of eligible abandoned helpers. Check status, preview a cleanup, and burn through the native Mac app's existing safety rules. Requires macOS 14 or later. Bundles the native app and stdio server for Apple Silicon and Intel; no language runtime or account required. Only explicitly registered disposable helpers are eligible for cleanup. Version 0.2 is ad-hoc signed, not notarized.

tools.name: burnzombies_status
tools.description: Check resource pressure and eligible abandoned helpers.

tools.name: burnzombies_preview
tools.description: Preview a cleanup through the native app's safety rules.

tools.name: burnzombies_burn
tools.description: Execute an approved cleanup preview; may terminate eligible disposable helpers.
